paragraphs: R' Chanina ben Padai. See the entry Rav Chinena bar Chiyya.[^1]

notes.text: The source has a middle dot after בן פדאי, rendered as a sentence stop before the pointer. Chanina ben Padai and Chinena bar Chiyya remain distinct; the former’s title is abbreviated R', while the target explicitly writes Rav.
